# voipms_phonebook_group (Resource)

Manages a phonebook group (`setPhonebookGroup` / `delPhonebookGroup`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "voipms_phonebook_group" "spam" {
  name = "Spam"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `members` (String) Comma-separated phonebook entry ids.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VoIP.ms phonebook group id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import voipms_phonebook_group.spam 5001
```
